parameter.name: enable_hello_fingerprint
parameter.description: Enables biometric FIDO2 enrollment and fingerprint authentication for Linux Hello. An eligible personal authenticator must support biometric user verification and hmac-secret. Ordinary fprintd fingerprint readers are not supported. After Hello PIN enrollment, eligible authenticators are offered for fingerprint enrollment. Once enrolled, fingerprint authentication is preferred with Hello PIN fallback when verification fails or the authenticator is unavailable. Disabling this option retains Hello PIN authentication.
parameter.conf_description: Enable biometric FIDO2 Linux Hello enrollment and authentication.
